plan: Given the common knowledge of rationality and a single round, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly above the expected value of the second highest bid. Since values are between $0 and $20, the expected value of the highest of the remaining two bidders is approximately 2/3 * 20 = $13.33. To win with high probability and minimize overpayment, I'll bid slightly above this. My value is $25, so I can afford to bid aggressively.

Given the common knowledge of rationality, the optimal bidding strategy converges towards bidding your true value. However, since the maximum value is $20, and my value is $32, I should bid the maximum allowed bid ($20). This ensures I win if any other bidder values the item less than $20. If another bidder values it higher, I lose, but I'm protected from overpaying given my high valuation.
